Yes: the matching paper is Socially Aware Music Recommendation: A Multi-Modal Graph Neural Networks for Collaborative Music Consumption and Community-Based Engagement by Kajwan Ziaoddini [1]. It proposes a multi-modal graph neural network for music recommendation that combines lyrics, audio, and visual data, and uses a heterogeneous graph over user-song interactions and user-user social relationships to model both personal preference and social influence [1].

The paper emphasizes socially aware and emotion-aware recommendation: it includes emotion-aware embeddings from acoustic and textual signals, is designed to be robust to missing modalities through fusion-free deep mutual learning, and reports better performance than existing methods on benchmark datasets [1]. Among the supplied results, this is the only Ziaoddini paper and the only one directly centered on a graph-based music recommendation model by that author [1].
